local_review.finding_body: The closed-file-set and one-library rules in §FS-contribution-contract.2 are violated: the diff for org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-webmvc-test:4.1.1 modifies metadata/org.junit.jupiter/junit-jupiter-engine/5.8.2/reachability-metadata.json. The local gate record independently reports human_intervention_required=true with that exact repo_fix_path. A complete correction cannot stay within the target contribution's allowed files, and this review is forbidden from editing another coordinate, so §FS-contribution-contract.5.5 requires maintainer intervention.
local_review.finding_title: Contribution modifies JUnit metadata outside the target coordinate
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the eventual PR diff, test contract, metadata file presence and scope, index, resolved 0/0 dynamic-access statistics, and local gate evidence. The target test is public, version-agnostic, in a separate package, exercises the library public API without Native Image skips or flags, and 0/0 is a valid no-calls result. The contribution cannot be approved because it also changes another coordinate.
